summary: This bill authorizes the Secretary of Labor to award grants to eligible entities to provide stipends to individuals enrolled in pre-apprenticeship programs, prioritizing those with barriers to employment, to cover transportation, lost wages, and certification costs, and requires grantees to report on program performance and outcomes.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to support individuals entering pre-apprenticeship and registered apprenticeship programs by providing stipends. These programs are often closely associated with skilled trades and can involve unions, and the bill explicitly mentions 'joint labor-management partnership' as an eligible applicant. By promoting pathways into skilled labor, it indirectly supports the workforce that unions represent, without directly altering labor laws or union power.
